title: Places & Directions (地点与方向)
description: Name places around town, use the compass points and left/right, ask where things are with 请问 and 怎么走, understand simple directions, and say whether somewhere is far or near.

notes.heading: 🏫 Places Around Town (地方 dìfang)
notes.body:
| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 学校 | xuéxiào | school |
| 医院 | yīyuàn | hospital |
| 商店 | shāngdiàn | shop / store |
| 公园 | gōngyuán | park |
| 车站 | chēzhàn | (bus/train) station |
| 银行 | yínháng | bank |
| 邮局 | yóujú | post office |
| 图书馆 | túshūguǎn | library |
| 饭馆 | fànguǎn | restaurant |

💡 **Worked Example:** 图书馆在公园的旁边。Túshūguǎn zài gōngyuán de pángbiān. — The library is next to the park.

📎 **Key Points:**
- 馆 **guǎn** appears in many public-building words: 图书馆 (book-building = library), 饭馆 (rice-building = restaurant).
- 车 **chē** = vehicle, 站 **zhàn** = station/stop, so 车站 = station.

notes.heading: 🧭 Compass Points: 东, 南, 西, 北
notes.body:
| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 东 | dōng | east |
| 南 | nán | south |
| 西 | xī | west |
| 北 | běi | north |
| 方向 | fāngxiàng | direction |

🔑 **How it works:** Chinese combines compass points in a different order from English:
- 东北 dōngběi = northeast (literally 'east-north')
- 西南 xīnán = southwest (literally 'west-south')

💡 **Worked Example:** 北京在中国的北方。Běijīng zài Zhōngguó de běifāng. — Beijing is in the north of China. (北方 **běifāng** = the north; 方 fāng = side/direction)

📎 **Key Point:** the city names 北京 and 南京 literally contain 北 (north) and 南 (south) — 'northern capital' and 'southern capital'.

notes.heading: 📍 Position Words: 前, 后, 左, 右, 旁边
notes.body:
Add 边 **biān** or 面 **miàn** (both mean 'side') to make position words:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 前面 | qiánmiàn | in front |
| 后面 | hòumiàn | behind |
| 左边 | zuǒbiān | on the left |
| 右边 | yòubiān | on the right |
| 旁边 | pángbiān | beside / next to |
| 对面 | duìmiàn | opposite |
| 附近 | fùjìn | nearby (area) |

**Pattern:** A 在 B 的 + position word — 'A is at B's (position)'.

💡 **Worked Example:**
- 银行在商店的左边。Yínháng zài shāngdiàn de zuǒbiān. — The bank is on the left of the shop.
- 车站在学校对面。Chēzhàn zài xuéxiào duìmiàn. — The station is opposite the school.

⚠️ **Common Mistake:** don't drop 的: it is 商店的左边 (the shop's left side), not 商店左边 in careful sentences.

notes.heading: ❓ Asking the Way: 请问 …
notes.body:
Start any question to a stranger with **请问 qǐngwèn** — 'may I ask…?' (literally 'please ask').

Two key question patterns:

1. **… 在哪儿？… zài nǎr?** — Where is …?
   - 请问，车站在哪儿？Qǐngwèn, chēzhàn zài nǎr? — Excuse me, where is the station?
2. **… 怎么走？… zěnme zǒu?** — How do I get to …? (literally: how to walk?)
   - 请问，去公园怎么走？Qǐngwèn, qù gōngyuán zěnme zǒu? — Excuse me, how do I get to the park?

📎 **Key Points:**
- 哪儿 **nǎr** = where (northern speech); 哪里 **nǎlǐ** means the same.
- 怎么 **zěnme** = how; 走 **zǒu** = to walk / to go.
- 去 **qù** + place = to go to a place: 去学校 (go to school).

notes.heading: 🗣️ Giving Simple Directions
notes.body:
Key direction-giving chunks:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 往前走 | wǎng qián zǒu | go straight ahead |
| 往左拐 | wǎng zuǒ guǎi | turn left |
| 往右拐 | wǎng yòu guǎi | turn right |
| 一直走 | yìzhí zǒu | keep going straight |
| 就到了 | jiù dào le | then you'll arrive |

🔑 **How it works:** 往 **wǎng** means 'towards' — 往左 (towards the left). 拐 **guǎi** means 'to turn'. 就 **jiù** adds the sense 'then / right away'.

💡 **Worked Example:** 往前走，到路口往右拐，银行就在你的左边。Wǎng qián zǒu, dào lùkǒu wǎng yòu guǎi, yínháng jiù zài nǐ de zuǒbiān. — Go straight, turn right at the junction, and the bank is on your left. (路口 **lùkǒu** = junction/crossing)

📎 **Key Point:** 拐 and 转 **zhuǎn** both mean 'turn' — 往左转 is equally common.

notes.heading: 📏 Far & Near: 远 and 近
notes.body:
- **远 yuǎn** = far
- **近 jìn** = near

To compare a distance between two places, use **离 lí** (from / away from):

**Pattern:** A 离 B + 远/近 — 'A is far/near from B'.

💡 **Worked Example:**
- 我家离学校很近。Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn. — My home is very near the school.
- 车站离这儿远吗？Chēzhàn lí zhèr yuǎn ma? — Is the station far from here?
- 不远，走路五分钟就到。Bù yuǎn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào. — Not far, five minutes on foot.

🔑 **How it works:** 这儿 **zhèr** = here, 那儿 **nàr** = there. To say how you go somewhere: 走路 (on foot), 坐车 (by vehicle), 坐公共汽车 (by bus).

⚠️ **Common Mistake:** 离 needs BOTH places — 我家离学校近, not 我家离近.

notes.heading: ✅ Putting It Together: A Full Direction Dialogue
notes.body:
A: 请问，图书馆怎么走？Qǐngwèn, túshūguǎn zěnme zǒu? — Excuse me, how do I get to the library?
B: 一直往前走，在第二个路口往左拐。Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, zài dì-èr ge lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi. — Keep going straight, then turn left at the second junction.
A: 离这儿远吗？Lí zhèr yuǎn ma? — Is it far from here?
B: 不远，就在公园旁边。Bù yuǎn, jiù zài gōngyuán pángbiān. — Not far, it's right next to the park.
A: 谢谢！Xièxie! — Thanks!
B: 不客气。Bú kèqi. — You're welcome.

🔑 **How it works:** 第 **dì** + number makes an ordinal: 第一个 (the first), 第二个 (the second), 第三个 (the third).

✅ **Check:** can you give directions from your school to the nearest shop using 往前走, 往左拐 and 在旁边?

flashcards.example: 我家离学校很近。Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn. (My home is very near the school.)
医院在公园的对面。Yīyuàn zài gōngyuán de duìmiàn. (The hospital is opposite the park.)
商店在哪儿？Shāngdiàn zài nǎr? (Where is the shop?)

flashcards.definition: Station / stop — for buses and trains.
flashcards.example: 请问，车站在哪儿？Qǐngwèn, chēzhàn zài nǎr? (Excuse me, where is the station?)
银行在商店的左边。Yínháng zài shāngdiàn de zuǒbiān. (The bank is on the left of the shop.)

flashcards.term: 东 dōng / 南 nán / 西 xī / 北 běi
flashcards.definition: East / south / west / north. Chinese says 东北 (east-north) for northeast.
flashcards.example: 北京在中国的北方。Běijīng zài Zhōngguó de běifāng. (Beijing is in the north of China.)

flashcards.definition: Left / right. 左边 = on the left, 右边 = on the right.

flashcards.term: 前面 qiánmiàn / 后面 hòumiàn
flashcards.example: 公园在学校的后面。Gōngyuán zài xuéxiào de hòumiàn. (The park is behind the school.)

flashcards.definition: Excuse me / may I ask — the polite way to start a question to a stranger.
flashcards.example: 请问，去公园怎么走？Qǐngwèn, qù gōngyuán zěnme zǒu? (Excuse me, how do I get to the park?)

flashcards.definition: How do I get (to)…? — literally 'how to walk'.
flashcards.example: 图书馆怎么走？Túshūguǎn zěnme zǒu? (How do I get to the library?)

flashcards.definition: Far / near. Used with 离: A 离 B 远 (A is far from B).
flashcards.example: 车站离这儿远吗？Chēzhàn lí zhèr yuǎn ma? (Is the station far from here?)

flashcards.definition: Towards — used in directions: 往前走 (go ahead), 往右拐 (turn right).
flashcards.example: 一直往前走。Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu. (Keep going straight ahead.)

questions.explanation: 学校 xuéxiào means school. 医院 is hospital, 商店 is shop and 公园 is park.
银行 yínháng means bank. A post office is 邮局 and a station is 车站.
东 dōng is east. The four compass points are 东 (east), 南 (south), 西 (west), 北 (north).
左 zuǒ means left; 右 yòu means right. You will hear both in 往左拐 (turn left) and 往右拐 (turn right).
远 yuǎn means far; its opposite is 近 jìn (near). 车站离这儿远吗？= Is the station far from here?

questions.stem: 请问，车站在哪儿？(Qǐngwèn, chēzhàn zài nǎr?) What is being asked?
questions.explanation: 在…哪儿 asks where something is: 车站在哪儿 = where is the station. 请问 makes the question polite.

questions.stem: 往右拐 (wǎng yòu guǎi) tells you to:
questions.explanation: 往 means towards, 右 is right, and 拐 means turn — so this direction tells you to turn right.

questions.stem: 图书馆在公园的旁边。(Túshūguǎn zài gōngyuán de pángbiān.) means:
choices: The library is opposite the park.
The library is behind the park.
The library is next to the park.
The park is inside the library.
questions.explanation: 旁边 means beside/next to, so the library is next to the park. Opposite would be 对面.

questions.stem: Which question asks 'How do I get to the park?'
choices: 公园远不远？Gōngyuán yuǎn bù yuǎn?
你去公园吗？Nǐ qù gōngyuán ma?
questions.explanation: 怎么走 (how to go/walk) asks for directions. 在哪儿 only asks where something is, and 远不远 asks about distance.

questions.stem: 我家离学校很近。(Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.) means:
choices: My home is far from the school.
My home is near the school.
I walk to school every day.
My school is near the park.
questions.explanation: 离 links two places (A 离 B) and 近 means near — so home is very near the school.
Chinese puts the compass words in its own order: 东北 = east + north = northeast. Southwest would be 西南.

questions.stem: You hear: 一直往前走，在第二个路口往左拐。What should you do?
choices: Turn left at the first junction
Go straight, then turn left at the second junction
Go straight, then turn right at the second junction
questions.explanation: 一直往前走 = keep going straight; 第二个路口 = the second junction (第 makes ordinals); 往左拐 = turn left.

questions.stem: A: 请问，医院离这儿远吗？B: 不远，走路五分钟就到。What does B mean?
choices: The hospital is far; take a bus.
The hospital is near; five minutes on foot.
The hospital closes in five minutes.
B doesn't know where the hospital is.
questions.explanation: 不远 means 'not far', and 走路五分钟就到 = five minutes walking and you'll arrive — so it is close and walkable.

questions.stem: Which sentence correctly says 'The bank is on the left of the shop'?
choices: 银行在商店左的边。Yínháng zài shāngdiàn zuǒ de biān.
银行在商店的左边。Yínháng zài shāngdiàn de zuǒbiān.
银行的左边在商店。Yínháng de zuǒbiān zài shāngdiàn.
商店在银行左。Shāngdiàn zài yínháng zuǒ.
questions.explanation: The pattern is A 在 B 的 + position word: the bank is at the shop's left side. Choice C reverses the two places.

questions.stem: A: 请问，去图书馆怎么走？B: 往前走，往右拐，图书馆就在邮局对面，离这儿很近。Where is the library?
choices: Next to the post office, far away
Opposite the post office, quite near
On the left of the park
questions.explanation: 对面 means opposite and 很近 means very near — so the library is opposite the post office and close by. 旁边 (next to) is not what was said.
